text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important task is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a cat or a bicycle. Another task is object detection, where the computer finds and locates multiple objects in one image. These technologies have many useful applications. For example, self-driving cars use computer vision to see the road, recognise traffic signs, and detect pedestrians and other vehicles. Doctors also use it to study medical images, and factories use it to check products for problems. Computer vision is changing many areas of our daily lives.
